section_summary.extract_value: This section reports one study (Study X) of 509 men recruited from the community in London, UK. Participants had mean age 25.18 (SD = 8.28) and mean self-reported BMI 24.01 (SD = 4.90); 73.1% identified as British White. Educational attainment included 17.7% undergraduate and 7.5% postgraduate (college-or-higher calculated as 25.2%).
